sentences.text: If you want to pass the national English test in June, you need a clear blueprint, not a vague hope.
sentences.translation: 如果你想在六月通过全国英语考试,你需要的不是一个模糊的希望,而是一个清晰的蓝图。

chunks.label: 条件状语从句(第一条件句)
chunks.text: If you want to pass the national English test in June

grammar.name: 第一条件句
grammar.note: if 从句用一般现在时表示条件,主句用 will/情态动词等表示结果。
grammar.example: If you study hard, you will pass the test.
grammar.exampleCn: 如果你努力学习,你就会通过考试。

grammar.name: not...but... 对比结构
grammar.note: not A but B 强调"不是A,而是B"。
grammar.example: It is not a dream but a plan.

grammarTags.phrase: If you want to pass the national English test in June

exercises.answer: It is not a dream but a plan.
exercises.note: not A but B 强调"不是A,而是B"。

sentences.text: If you plan your week with a concise timetable, you will find time for every subject.
sentences.translation: 如果你用一份简洁的时间表规划一周,你就会为每门功课找到时间。

grammar.name: 第一条件句
grammar.note: if + 一般现在时,主句 will + 动词原形。

exercises.answer: If you start early, you will finish on time.

sentences.text: Should you fall behind, do not panic; adjust the plan rather than abandon it.
sentences.translation: 万一你落后了,不要惊慌;调整计划,而不是放弃它。

grammar.name: 倒装条件句
grammar.note: Should + 主语 + 动词原形 = If + 主语 + should...,用于正式文体表万一。
grammar.example: Should you need help, call me.
grammar.exampleCn: 万一你需要帮助,就打电话给我。

exercises.prompt: 回译:万一你需要帮助,就打电话给我。
exercises.answer: Should you need help, call me.
exercises.note: Should + 主语 + 动词原形 = If + 主语 + should...,用于正式文体表万一。

sentences.text: Even if you find the task hard, keep to the schedule and do not stop.
sentences.translation: 即使你觉得任务很难,也要坚持按计划进行,不要停下来。

chunks.label: 让步状语从句

grammar.name: even if 让步条件句
grammar.note: even if 意为"即使",从句提出让步条件,主句照常执行。

grammarTags.phrase: Even if you find the task hard
grammarTags.name: even if 让步条件句

exercises.answer: Even if it rains, we will go.
exercises.note: even if 意为"即使",从句提出让步条件,主句照常执行。

sentences.text: Unless you activate the plan on day one, your energy will fade within a week.
sentences.translation: 除非你第一天就启动计划,否则你的精力会在一周内消退。

chunks.label: 条件状语从句(unless)

grammar.name: unless 条件句
grammar.example: Unless you try, you will never know.

grammarTags.phrase: Unless you activate the plan on day one
grammarTags.name: unless 条件句

exercises.prompt: 回译:除非你去尝试,否则你永远不会知道。
exercises.answer: Unless you try, you will never know.

sentences.text: If you ask me, half an hour of reading each morning will do more than any magic method.
sentences.translation: 依我看,每天早晨半小时的阅读比任何神奇的方法都更有用。

grammar.exampleCn: 阅读比任何技巧都更有帮助。

sentences.text: If you start with a small goal, the task will not seem so large.
sentences.translation: 如果你从小目标开始,任务就不会显得那么庞大。

sentences.text: Provided that you review your progress every week, you will see steady improvement.
sentences.translation: 只要你每周回顾自己的进步,就能看到稳步提升。

grammar.exampleCn: 只要你每天练习,你就会进步。

sentences.text: A notable counselor can not authorize your success; the effort must come from within.
sentences.translation: 一位出色的顾问也无法替你批准成功;努力必须来自你自身。

chunks.label: 主干(主谓宾)
chunks.text: A notable counselor can not authorize your success

grammar.note: 情态动词后接动词原形;can not 表"不能",must 表"必须"。
grammar.example: You must act, not just wish.
grammar.exampleCn: 你必须行动,而不只是空想。

sentences.text: Remember that a coherent plan with periodic review will always beat a clever excuse.
sentences.translation: 记住:一份连贯的、有定期回顾的计划,总能胜过聪明的借口。
